Messages.Author: Trey Morita
Messages.Body:
On 16 Jul 2002 22:00:10 -0700, lizard...@hotmail.com (lizardusrex) wrote:
> Just to make sure I need to know if vampires i ashheap are controlled.

Vampires in the ashheap are not controlled.

> The reason I ask is because Gisela burn uncontrolled Vampires and
> after that I want to take control of them with Daemonic Possession
> from the ashheap.

Vampires that Gisela burns were never controlled, and are thus not legal targets of Daemonic Possession.
"[nec] Only usable when a minion controlled by another Methuselah has been burned since your last turn."

> I am also in need to know what "since your last turn" refer to. Does
> that mean that Daemonic possession cant be used if I burn a vampire in
> my own turn?

Think back to the last time you ended your turn ("I transfer, discard blah, and I'm done."). Everything that happened after that is "since your
last turn", including things that you have done this turn.

Trey

Messages.Author: Halcyan 2

>> > Just to make sure I need to know if vampires i ashheap are controlled.
>>
>> Vampires in the ashheap are not controlled.
>
>But they are not in the "uncontrolled region" either. So, no sugar.

False logic. Vampires in my crypt or in that shoebox back at home aren't in the
"uncontrolled region" either. So does that make them "controlled?"

"Controlled" in Jyhad/VTES has a rather specific meaning: (roughly) brought
into play by transferring enough blood to the vampire while it was in the
uncontrolled region or by some other special means (Soul Gem, Possession,
etc.).

Halcyan 2

>Are vampires in torpor not in the uncontroled region?

No.

There are three "bits".

1) Uncontrolled.
2) Controlled, but in torpor.
3) Controlled, but not in torpor.
